verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs say passkeys can be saved in the vault and autofilled through the browser extension or mobile apps across websites and apps, which is passkey sign-in beyond its separate TOTP authenticator. Its llms.txt also describes the product as a manager for 'passwords, passkeys, and secrets'. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of passkey sign-in, and detailed documentation of per-platform passkey creation and sign-in flows (support is a single summary sentence).

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes

citations.quote: Save passkeys in your Bitwarden vault and use the browser extension or mobile apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day.
The most trusted open source password manager for passwords, passkeys, and secrets
